notes: SCOPE: not part of the CA/Collections-core cluster; it is the Wardrobe tab of the Collections window (transmog + illusions + item sets + outfits + incarnations/spell visuals/cosmetics/mounts/companions/toys). Reasonable P1/P2 target; nothing in it is needed to open the CA tree. LOADING: LoadOnDemand, Dependencies=Ascension_Collections; AppearanceWardrobeFrame is parented to the global Collections frame in XML so Collections must be loaded first (it is, via dependency). The Collections tab lazily loads this addon ONLY through the tab's PreClick (Collections.lua:89); Collections:GoToTab(Collections.Tabs.Wardrobe) (used by ShowAppearanceWardrobe/ShowAppearanceCategory/TryOnAppearance) calls SelectTabID directly, which resolves _G['AppearanceWardrobeFrame'] and silently shows nothing if the addon is not yet loaded - the shim should call AppearanceUI_LoadUI() before GoToTab in those helpers (a compat/FrameXML fix, not an addon edit). NAMESPACE DUMP TRAP: in ext-lua-bindings.tsv the whole appearance block (site_va 0x100cd86a-0x100cdedf) carries namespace labels shifted by one: dump 'C_AppearanceCollection' run 2 (0x100cd9d3-0x100cdb7f) == Lua C_Appearance (24 fns incl. GetItemSetAppearanceID which this addon does not use); dump 'C_Appearance' == Lua C_AppearanceOutfit (GetAppearanceOutfits, GetOutfitInfo, SetPendingOutfit, SaveOutfit, DeleteOutfit, GetCurrentOutfitName); dump 'C_AppearanceOutfit' (IsBound, CanBind, GetScalingLevel) are C_Item members; dump 'C_Item' (GetAppearances, GetSetName, GetItemSetNumCollected) == Lua C_ItemSet; dump 'C_ItemSet' (GetCameraInfo, GetItemCameraID) == Lua C_UICamera. p0-framexml-gap.json's ns_unknown list for C_Appearance/C_AppearanceOutfit/C_ItemSet.GetAppearances is this artifact - all are native. No Lua anywhere defines or aliases C_Appearance, C_AppearanceCollection, C_AppearanceOutfit, C_ItemSet, C_UICamera, C_Config or C_Logger. LATENT BUG: AppearanceUI.OpenToItemSet(number) calls C_ItemSet.GetItemSetName which does not exist (native is GetSetName); only the string path is exercised. STATE MODEL the shim must reproduce: (1) 'current view' is server-state-like in the native: ApplyCategoryFilter(category, search, filter, sort) selects it, GetCategoryMaxPages/GetCategoryAppearances(page) read it (18 tiles/page, Item1..Item18 laid out 6x3); (2) pending set per categoryID with 0 meaning 'strip transmog', mutated only through the C_Appearance calls and observed only through PENDING_APPEARANCE_CHANGED; (3) applied set per category (GetAppearanceForCategory) changed only by APPLY_PENDING_APPEARANCE_RESULT; (4) categories 1..16 map 1:1 to INVSLOTs in FrameXML/Util/AppearanceUtil.lua (13/14 = MH/OH, 15/16 = their illusions, 12 = ranged); categoryID > INVSLOT_LAST_EQUIPPED (19) is treated as a spell/cosmetic category (AppearancePlayerModelMixin.lua:159); INCARNATION categories use CREATURE display type and SetCreature(displayID) on the player model; (5) outfits are keyed by NAME, the tile list for APPEARANCE_TYPE_OUTFIT is a list of strings with the NEW_OUTFIT global string as the 'new' tile. WIRE PROTOCOL: DESIGN.md section 5 has no appearance verbs; a minimal set would be APPEARANCE STATE (collected ids, applied per category, outfits, cansee), APPEARANCE APPLY <cat:id,...> -> EVENT APPLY_PENDING_APPEARANCE_RESULT, APPEARANCE OUTFIT SAVE|DELETE <name> -> EVENT APPEARANCE_OUTFIT_SAVED_RESULT, APPEARANCE CANSEE <item> <spell>; collection pushes as EVENT APPEARANCE_COLLECTED <id>. The catalogue itself (thousands of appearances) belongs in generated data/ tables, not on the wire. RENDERING LIMITS ON STOCK: SetSpellVisual/SetSpell (spell-visual and cosmetic previews) have no stock equivalent -> those tiles render as the undressed player; the SPELL display type uses a plain icon and works; illusion previews rely on TryOn('item:id:enchant') which stock honours. The three EventRegistry/ItemQueryListener async paths need a polling replacement (no cache events on 3.3.5a). ATLAS: all SetAtlas calls are pure Lua over SharedXML/AtlasInfo.lua, but the referenced BLPs are 4.x-7.x art that must ship with the client package (see data_files); AtlasUtil:Unpack asserts on a missing name, so a missing race background (transmog-background-race-<race>) is a hard error in AppearancePlayerModelMixin:OnLoad. GLOBAL STRINGS: ~80 strings come from the MPQ GlobalStrings.lua, not from any loose Lua; TRANSMOG_COLLECTED is concatenated on every refresh and NEW_OUTFIT is compared as a value, so the shim must define them all (list in data_files) before this addon runs. TEMPLATES USED (all SharedXML, load before via compat): RaisedPortraitFrameTemplateNoBackground, NineSlicePanelTemplate2 (layoutType=InsetFrameTemplate), SharedGoldRedButtonTemplate, SharedButtonTemplate, StandardButtonTemplate, CollectionsBackgroundTemplate, SearchBoxTemplate, BetterStatusBarTemplate (bar-atlas/text attributes), LeftButtonTemplate, RightButtonTemplate, ExternalLinkButtonTemplate, InputBlockLoadingTemplate (SharedXML/SharedPanelTemplates.xml), FilterDropDownButtonTemplate (SharedXML/FilterDropDown.xml), TabSystemTopTabTemplate (SharedXML/TabSystem/TabSystemTemplates.xml); fonts GameFontRed, ErrorFont (FrameXML/FontStyles.xml - Ascension's, ErrorFont is not stock), GameFontHighlightOutlineTiny (SharedXML/CustomFontStyles.xml). MISC: AppearanceTemplates.xml lists AppearanceCategoryTabMixin.lua twice (harmless). The collection grid updates one tile per frame via OnUpdate (InternalUpdateAppearances, 10 ms spacing) so a slow native is tolerated.
